name: @lightwebinc/bcommon
description: TypeScript twins of the bcommon Go library: deterministic CBOR, the bounded record reader, store references, BRC-42 reader derivation, PushDrop reading and field signatures, funding decode, the carrier check and the BEEF shapes a host admits a carrier and a mined token in, RFC 6962 roots and compact paths over leaves of any length, the CHIRP (BRC-167) profile 1 codec and closure check, for overlay topic managers and lookup services, the renderer filter for text a web page shows, the value discriminator for a payment a host takes, and, for a Node host module, its terms route with BRC-104 hardening, the payee ledger and payment acceptance

scripts.prepack: npm run build -- --sourceMap false && node -e "for (const f of ['LICENSE', 'NOTICE']) require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../' + f, f)"
